quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #22
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 21

questions.question: When should you stop holding a hand signal for a turn?

options.text: In the middle of the turn
After completing the turn
Just before making the turn
Three or four seconds before making the turn

questions.correctAnswerText: Just before making the turn
questions.explanation: Hold the hand signal until you are close enough to the intersection so others know you plan to turn. Stop signaling before you turn. You need both hands on the wheel while turning.

questions.question: Blood alcohol content (BAC) does NOT depend on:

options.text: Your body weight.
How much you drink.
How much time passes between drinks.
How physically fit you are.

questions.correctAnswerText: How physically fit you are.
questions.explanation: BAC depends on how much alcohol you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. Being physically fit does not affect your BAC.

questions.question: An approaching driver's high beams are too bright. Where should you look?

options.text: At the wheels of the approaching vehicle.
Toward the right side of the road.
Toward the left side of the road.
Straight down the middle of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road to avoid being blinded. This allows you to see the road and stay in your lane until the other vehicle passes.

questions.question: A leaking exhaust system can:

options.text: Cause excessive oil use.
Require your vehicle to have a tune-up sooner than normal.
Make you drowsy while driving.
Set grass fires on country roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make you drowsy while driving.
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes toxic gases and cools hot gases from the engine. Fumes from a leaky exhaust system are dangerous and can make you drowsy while driving.

questions.question: When making a left turn, you should not:

options.text: Signal to other drivers.
Cut the corner.
Slow down.
Move to the center or far left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cut the corner.
questions.explanation: Slow down and signal before turning left. Do not cut the corner short, as this can interfere with other vehicles.

questions.question: You must pull over for an emergency vehicle:

options.text: No matter which direction it is coming from.
Only if it is following you.
Only if it is coming toward you.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter which direction it is coming from.
questions.explanation: Pull over to the right edge and stop for any emergency vehicle with flashing lights, whether it is behind you or coming toward you.

questions.question: What color are signs for public recreation areas?

options.text: Orange.
Red.
Green.
Brown.

questions.correctAnswerText: Brown.
questions.explanation: Brown signs mark public recreation areas and places of historical interest. They help travelers find important locations.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic light means the same as a:

options.text: Solid red light.
Stop sign.
Yield sign.
Caution sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: Use low beam headlights:

options.text: When driving in fog, dust, or rain.
When following closely behind another vehicle at night.
Within 500 feet of an oncoming vehicle at night.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Use low beams when driving at night, following closely behind another vehicle, or within 500 feet of an oncoming vehicle. Also use low beams in fog, rain, dust, sleet, or snow.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Intersection ahead.
Steep downhill ahead.
Winding road.
Merging traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep downhill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: You are waiting in the intersection to turn left. What should you do?

options.text: Signal and turn your wheels to the left.
Signal and keep your wheels straight.
Flash your headlights to ask other drivers to let you through.
Drive around the back of a car that blocks you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal and keep your wheels straight.
questions.explanation: Always signal before turning. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn left. If a car hits you from behind, straight wheels keep you from being pushed into oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A side road is ahead.
Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.
You have the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. An island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: It is safe for other drivers to follow motorcycles closely.
A motorcycle is more balanced with two riders than with one.
You must change lanes completely when passing a motorcycle.
A motorcycle's brake lights turn on when the rider slows down.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must change lanes completely when passing a motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles need the full width of a lane. Make sure your entire vehicle is in the left lane before passing a motorcycle.

questions.question: You cannot park within ____ of an intersection.

options.text: 20 feet
30 feet
35 feet
45 feet

questions.correctAnswerText: 20 feet
questions.explanation: Do not park within 20 feet of an intersection. Parking too close can cause crashes.

questions.question: When you see a steady green arrow on a traffic signal, you:

options.text: Should merge into a lane in the direction of the arrow.
Should slow down or stop if it is safe.
May turn in the direction of the arrow if the path is clear of traffic and pedestrians.
May drive straight through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn in the direction of the arrow if the path is clear of traffic and pedestrians.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can turn in that direction. You must be in the correct lane to turn. Let any vehicles or pedestrians already in the intersection go first.

questions.question: If your car skids, turn your steering wheel:

options.text: To keep the front wheels straight.
In the direction you want the car to go.
In the opposite direction of the skid.
In any direction. The direction does not matter.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the direction you want the car to go.
questions.explanation: If your car skids, turn the steering wheel in the direction you want the car to go. When the car starts to straighten out, turn the wheel back the other way.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A steep hill is ahead.
A pedestrian crossing is ahead.
A low railroad crossing is ahead.
Low clearance ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low clearance ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low overpass ahead. Do not drive through if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: When merging onto a freeway, it is best to:

options.text: Drive slowly while looking for an opening.
Speed up faster than the traffic already on the freeway.
Turn on your hazard lights until you are safely on the freeway.
Speed up to match the freeway traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match the freeway traffic.
questions.explanation: Use the on-ramp to speed up to the same speed as freeway traffic. This helps you merge smoothly and safely. You must yield to traffic already on the freeway.

questions.question: At a stop sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for tailgating cars.
Move when the car ahead of you moves.
Look right, then left, then right again.
Look left, then right, then left again.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look left, then right, then left again.
questions.explanation: Look left first because cars coming from the left are closer to you. Then look right, then left again to check for any traffic you might have missed.

questions.question: What is a "No zone"?

options.text: An area where passing is not allowed
A one-way traffic area
The blind spot around a large truck or vehicle
An area for motor vehicles only

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot around a large truck or vehicle
questions.explanation: "No zones" are large blind spots around trucks and big vehicles. Small vehicles should not stay in these blind spots.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow pedestrian hybrid beacon signal mean?

options.text: Drivers may go forward carefully.
Drivers should slow down and be ready to stop.
Drivers must stop completely.
No pedestrians are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers should slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pedestrian hybrid beacons are used at crossings. A flashing yellow light means drivers should slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ signs that show directions and distances to drivers.

options.text: Yellow
Red
Green
White

questions.correctAnswerText: Green
questions.explanation: Guide signs have a green background. They show directions and distances to specific places. They help drivers who are unfamiliar with an area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop.
No U-turn.
Yield.
Do not enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not enter.
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: Highway signs that require drivers to follow an instruction are called:

options.text: Regulatory signs.
Warning signs.
Information signs.
Guide signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Regulatory signs.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs require drivers to follow an instruction. Breaking this rule can result in a penalty.

questions.question: What does a flashing red pedestrian hybrid beacon signal mean?

options.text: Drivers may go forward carefully.
Drivers should slow down and be ready to stop.
Drivers must stop completely and go only if the crosswalk is clear.
No pedestrians are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must stop completely and go only if the crosswalk is clear.
questions.explanation: Pedestrian hybrid beacons are used at crossings. A flashing red light means drivers must stop completely before going forward.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in an urban district if no sign says otherwise?

options.text: 15 mph.
30 mph.
45 mph.
55 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: 30 mph.
questions.explanation: In an urban district, the speed limit is 30 miles per hour unless a different speed limit is posted. Follow posted speed limits when they appear.

questions.question: You turn left from a two-way street onto a one-way street. After the turn, where should your car be?

options.text: In the right lane.
In the center of the street.
In the left lane.
In the lane with the least traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the left lane.
questions.explanation: When turning left onto a one-way street, finish the turn in the lane closest to where you came from.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a steady yellow arrow traffic light?

options.text: Merge into the lane the arrow points to.
Slow down and stop if safe to do so.
Turn left after letting oncoming traffic and pedestrians go first.
Go forward because you have the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stop if safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow arrow means a red arrow is coming next. Stop unless you are already inside the intersection.

questions.question: Your car's accelerator gets stuck open while driving on a busy street. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn.
Press the brakes hard.
Turn on your four-way flashers.
Turn off the ignition carefully without locking the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off the ignition carefully without locking the steering wheel.
questions.explanation: If your accelerator sticks, the car will keep speeding even if you lift your foot. Turn off the ignition by moving the switch just enough to stop the engine. Be careful not to lock the steering wheel. Then use the brakes and move to a safe spot.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right has one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right because of roadwork ahead.
Slow down because the road turns sharply in this direction.
A side road crosses on your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road turns sharply in this direction.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead makes a sharp turn in this direction. Slow down before the turn just as you would at an intersection.
